svg.title: 26100fe-f2024:q4
svg.desc: The actual first-octant solid lies below the cone \(z=r\) and inside the cylinder \(r=3\). The spherical radial ceiling depends on the polar angle. Setup: \(0\le\theta\le\pi/2,\quad\pi/4\le\phi\le\pi/2,\quad0\le\rho\le3\csc\phi;\quad y\,dV=\rho^3\sin^2\phi\sin\theta\,d\rho d\phi d\theta\)
